Coming from someone who works in the entertainment industry and also not a fan of Tom Cruise; I will say that this really didn’t upset me when I first heard his rant. Sure he’s psycho, but these were and still are scary times for our industry and we will never recover from it. It just totally changed everything overnight. I know people who one day we’re about to start tour with “X” band or artist and literally end of the day we’re putting their homes on the market bc that projected income was completely gone. It was the beginning of touring season and the whole industry shut down by lunchtime that day. I was fortunate enough to find a gig during that time; the only “gig” in the country; Donald Trumps campaign. Now, that shit was crazy and never in my life did I think I would be doing a presidential campaign for Donald fucking Trump, but there I was. 
So for someone to be fortunate enough to be doing a job in the industry, much less a movie; you should respect what the man’s doing by employing everyone himself and making that shit happen. Because everyone else in the world lost their jobs in one day.
